headline: Tax appeal hearings for three properties on Church Street and Starr Farm Road.
summary: The board will hold hearings on property tax appeals from AGEM Properties, LLC, Kennedy Brothers Inc., and 98 Starr Farm Road LLC. It will also review and approve draft minutes from August 27, 2026.
items: Hearing: AGEM Properties, LLC, 66-78 Church Street, 044-4-024-000, 1:00 pm
